description: Player character shows visible foot sliding and popping during 90-degree and 180-degree turns at run speed.

unapplied_conditions.reason: Project records that the development environment represents target presentation for character motion.

required_gates.notes: Gameplay-camera recording of idle, start, run, 45/90/180-degree turns, stop and settle, before and after. Numerical foot-slide diagnostics are supplementary only.

required_gates.routine_basis: Bounded fix inside the existing animation state setup; no persisted data or public behaviour changes.
required_gates.notes: Clip and blend setup load without errors in a running build; automated tests if the project has animation-state tests.

unapplied_conditions.reason: The fix touches no saved or persisted data.

omitted_gates.reason: Camera configuration is not changed by this task; camera-composition cross-reviews how motion reads through the existing camera. Becomes relevant if framing changes are proposed.
No new clips or runtime systems expected; re-evaluate if blend setup grows.

human_review.not_required_reason: Corrective work inside the approved locomotion baseline in ANIMATION.md; no baseline, canonical asset or authority change. Cross-review by camera-composition closes ANIMATION.

out_of_scope: Changing gameplay movement speed or turn rate
Rig or skin rebuild unless technical-art finds a rig cause
rationale: Success depends on motion quality judged from the gameplay camera, so character-animation is primary; technical-art owns rig and blend setup causes. The fix stays inside the approved locomotion baseline, so the proportional policy is cross-review, not Human Review.
